evidence.quote: Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

notes: The tuition amount of 178 euros per year is the public licence rate shown on the Parcoursup page for this programme; the pages do not state a differentiated non-EU rate for this programme, and the non-EU differentiated rates (2,902 euros for Licence) are given by Campus France as a general rule for public institutions, not for this programme. The French page only says a B2 level of French is required, it does not name any accepted certificate; the Campus France page says the TCF, DELF B2 or DALF certification is compulsory for the Études en France procedure, unless exempted, so certificate names are covered by the manual_check rule. Application deadlines (e.g., the Campus France platform dates) are given for other programmes/pages, not for this licence. English B2 competence is mentioned as a competence in the national framework, but the programme is taught in French.

note.fr: L'admission est décidée par une commission qui examine les résultats scolaires, les méthodes de travail, le savoir-être et la motivation. Aucun seuil de notes n'est publié.
note.en: Admission is decided by a commission reviewing academic results, work methods, behaviour and motivation. No grade threshold is published.

evidence.quote: Plus le pourcentage est élevé plus le critère compte dans l'examen des candidatures.

note.fr: Un certificat de français (TCF, DELF B2 ou DALF) est obligatoire pour la procédure Études en France, sauf cas de dispense.
note.en: A French certificate (TCF, DELF B2 or DALF) is compulsory for the Études en France procedure, unless exempted.

evidence.quote: Sauf cas de dispense, la certification de français (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) est obligatoire dans le cadre de la procédure de candidature sur la plateforme Études en France.
